title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
title_zh: 智能体能否学会预测自身的失败？基于结果的LLM智能体置信度校准

paragraphs.en: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent’s own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step’s confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68–0.85 , and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ∼ \sim 4.3 × \times more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12 , and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.
paragraphs.zh: 控制一个正在执行任务的 LLM 智能体意味着在长期任务的每一步中，都需要决定是信任其下一步行动、选择弃权，还是将决策权交给人类。 这一决策需要每一步都具备信心信号，以预测当前的执行流程最终能否成功。 智能体自身报告的口头化信心水平是一个自然的候选指标，但现有的强化学习方法通常将其与当前步骤决策的正确性进行校准。 我们提出一种方法，将其与多步回合的最终结果进行校准：在 GRPO 框架下，某项任务的所有执行流程集合提供了成功标签，而适当的评分规则则根据实际结果对每一步的信心水平进行打分。 在 ALFWorld、TextWorld 和 WebShop 环境中，基于 Qwen2.5-7B 智能体记录轨迹的离线强化学习实验中，步骤信心与回合结果相关的 AUROC 从接近随机水平提升至 0.68–0.85，而智能体最自信的 10% 步骤中，成功概率比平均水平高出 ∼ \sim 4.3 × \times。 在 ALFWorld 的在线强化学习实验中，通过引入四种校准奖励，早期步骤的 AUROC 得到提升，预期校准误差从 0.42 降至 0.12 以下；选择性执行策略的表现优于未经训练的智能体和仅进行格式优化的强化学习对照组，且未导致任务成功率下降。 我们还提出了一种评估协议，能够区分回合深度、任务难度和尝试层面的预见能力，从而明确改进空间所在：训练后的智能体从第一步就能识别出哪些任务会失败，但在同一任务中区分成功尝试与失败尝试则更具挑战性，不过在 TextWorld 中已出现部分早期窗口信号。

paragraphs.en: Acting LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, partially observable environments ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Côté et al., 2019 ; Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Hausknecht et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , where a single episode spans dozens of actions under compounding uncertainty. Controlling such an agent at runtime requires an estimate of the probability that the current attempt will succeed, so that it can continue with the action, verify with observation, or escalate to a human ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . Such a probability estimate can work as a confidence signal that predicts whether the current rollout will ultimately reach the goal, not whether the current step is locally correct.
paragraphs.zh: 行动的大型语言模型智能体越来越多地运行在长期、部分可观察的环境中（Shridhar 等人，2021；Yao 等人，2022；Côté 等人，2019；Shridhar 等人，2020；Hausknecht 等人，2020；Wang 等人，2022；Zhou 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2024），在这些环境中，单个回合可能包含数十次行动，并伴随着累积的不确定性。 在运行时控制此类智能体需要估计当前尝试成功的可能性，以便它能够继续执行该行动、通过观察进行验证，或升级至人类介入（Kadavath 等人，2022）。 这样的概率估计可以作为一种置信度信号，用于预测当前的执行流程最终能否达成目标，而非判断当前步骤在局部上是否正确。

paragraphs.en: The natural candidate is a self-reported verbalized confidence of an agent. Without additional focused training, smaller LLMs are poorly calibrated and barely predictive (§ 6 ). Previous works on Reinforcement Learning (RL) for calibration ( Damani et al., 2025 ; Bani-Harouni et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Xuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) focus on training confidence to predict either a single answer or step-level correctness. Such greedy optimization signals train the model to be locally predictive, promising no predictiveness for eventual outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 最自然的候选方案是智能体自我报告的口头化置信度。 在没有额外针对性训练的情况下，较小的 LLM 校准效果很差，几乎无法进行预测（§ 6）。 以往关于校准强化学习（RL）的研究（Damani et al., 2025；Bani-Harouni et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b；Xuan et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026）主要集中在训练置信度以预测单个答案或步骤层面的正确性。 这种贪心优化信号会训练模型在局部层面具备预测能力，但无法保证对最终结果具有预测性。

paragraphs.en: We propose a methodology to train a step-wise confidence signal that could predict the eventual outcome of the task. Under group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), the rollouts for a task supply success labels at no extra cost. We define the per-step reward as a proper scoring rule on the step confidence against the realized outcome, with other reward terms. We conduct offline & online RL training. Our evaluation protocol separates what the aggregate score mixes (§ 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种训练逐步置信信号的方法，该信号能够预测任务的最终结果。 在群体相对策略优化（GRPO）框架下，任务执行过程无需额外成本即可提供成功标签。 我们将每一步的奖励定义为基于步骤置信度与实际结果之间的适当评分规则，并包含其他奖励项。 我们进行了离线和在线强化学习训练。 我们的评估协议区分了综合得分所混合的内容（§ 3.2）。

sents.en: We propose a methodology to train a step-wise confidence signal that could predict the eventual outcome of the task.
sents.zh: 我们提出一种训练逐步置信信号的方法，该信号能够预测任务的最终结果。

sents.en: We conduct offline & online RL training.
sents.zh: 我们进行了离线和在线强化学习训练。

sents.en: Our evaluation protocol separates what the aggregate score mixes (§ 3.2 ).
sents.zh: 我们的评估协议区分了综合得分所混合的内容（§ 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: Our approach reveals that outcome-grounded calibration can turn a weak agent’s confidence into a reliable early signal of eventual outcome, consistently across environments and training regimes. Our evaluation protocol then reveals precisely where this new ability comes from, and where it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法表明，以结果为导向的校准能够将弱势智能体的置信度转化为对最终结果的可靠早期信号，且这一效果在不同环境和训练方案中均保持一致。 随后，我们的评估协议揭示了这种新能力究竟源自何处，以及它并未源自何处。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions include: (i) Outcome-grounded calibration training under GRPO, (ii) an evaluation protocol for episodic confidence, and (iii) an empirical analysis of what an LLM learns during such a training process.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献包括：(i) 基于结果的 GRPO 校准训练，(ii) 一种用于评估情境置信度的评估协议，以及 (iii) 对大型语言模型在此类训练过程中所学内容的实证分析。

paragraphs.en: A broad line of work reads a confidence out of a model without additional training: verbalized probabilities ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ) , self-consistency and self-evaluation ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) , and elicitation strategies for black-box models ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) . A related line of work documents that post-hoc calibration of neural classifiers degrades with scale and training ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . These works primarily target synchronous single-answer correctness, where confidence degrades on weak models, precisely the area we target.
paragraphs.zh: 有一系列广泛的研究无需额外训练即可从模型中读取置信度：包括语言化概率（Lin et al., 2022；Tian et al., 2023）、自一致性与自我评估（Kadavath et al., 2022），以及针对黑箱模型的置信度提取策略（Xiong et al., 2024）。 相关研究指出，神经分类器的后验校准效果会随着模型规模和训练量的增加而下降（Guo et al., 2017）。 这些研究主要关注同步单答案的正确性，其中弱模型的置信度会下降，而这正是我们所关注的领域。

paragraphs.en: The most closely related work trains calibration. RLCR ( Damani et al., 2025 ) optimizes a Brier reward for verbalized confidence, and related efforts tie confidence to reward shaping, uncertainty, or abstention in non-agentic settings ( Bani-Harouni et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Leng et al., 2025 ; Yaldiz et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . All optimize the calibration of a single synchronous output ; none targets the eventual success of an agent through a long-horizon task.

paragraphs.en: Three concurrent methods are closest. CAR/MSCR ( Xuan et al., 2026 ) and CAPO ( Wang et al., 2026b ) train confidence in tool-use and reasoning settings, and RLCR ( Damani et al., 2025 ) in single-answer QA; all optimize confidence against the synchronous correctness of the current answer or step, whereas we target the predictive success of the eventual rollout. They differ from us in how the signal is produced and rewarded: CAPO reads a perplexity-derived confidence and reshapes the advantage estimator through a consistency-and-regret construction, and MSCR uses a margin reward, while we train an explicit verbalized token under a lightweight per-completion calibration reward.
paragraphs.zh: 三种并发方法最为接近。 CAR/MSCR（Xuan 等人，2026）和 CAPO（Wang 等人，2026b）在工具使用和推理场景中训练对置信度的把握，RLCR（Damani 等人，2025）则在单答案问答题中进行训练；它们都通过当前答案或步骤的同步正确性来优化置信度，而我们的目标则是最终展开过程的预测成功率。 它们在信号的产生和奖励方式上与我们不同：CAPO 读取由困惑度推导出的置信度，并通过一致性与遗憾构建机制重塑优势估计器；MSCR 则使用边际奖励，而我们则在一个轻量级的每次完成校准奖励下训练一个明确的言语化标记。

paragraphs.en: Pooled AUROC compares any success-step with any failure-step and holds none of the confounds fixed. Between-task AUROC collapses each task to its mean confidence, leaving only task difficulty (i). Within-task AUROC compares succeeding against failing attempts of the same task, cancelling difficulty to isolate attempt-level foresight (ii). Depth-matched within-task AUROC compares them only at the same step index, so neither difficulty nor depth contributes and only foresight survives (iii). Against each we report a depth-only model-free baseline scoring every step by − t -t : over all steps it can match or beat a real signal, but the early window and step 0 drive it to chance, so any gain there reflects foresight rather than position. At step 0 every attempt sees the same observation, so a gain can arise only from ranking tasks or from the first sampled action, before any environment feedback. All formal definitions appear in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 池化 AUROC 将任何成功步骤与任何失败步骤进行比较，且不固定任何混淆因素。 任务间 AUROC 将每个任务简化为其平均置信度，仅保留任务难度（i）。 任务内 AUROC 比较同一任务中成功的尝试与失败的尝试，从而消除难度影响，以孤立尝试层面的预见性（ii）。 深度匹配的任务内 AUROC 仅在相同步骤索引上对它们进行比较，因此难度和深度均不产生影响，只有预见性得以保留（iii）。 针对每种方法，我们报告了一个仅基于深度的模型无关基线，该基线通过 − t -t 为每个步骤评分：在所有步骤中，它可能匹配或超越真实信号，但早期窗口和步骤 0 会使其结果趋近于随机水平，因此任何在此处的提升都反映了预见性，而非位置。 在步骤 0，每次尝试都观察到相同的信息，因此提升只能源于任务的排序或首次采样的动作，而在此之前尚未获得任何环境反馈。 所有正式定义均见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: We report two kinds of metrics. For calibration , how well confidence matches outcome frequency: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) with 10 equal-width bins ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , and the Brier score ( BRIER, 1950 ) . For selective execution , how useful confidence is for gating actions: the success rate among the top- q q % most confident steps in a window ( q = 10 , 25 q=10,25 ), and task-level triage (the success rate when only the top 50% of tasks by mean early confidence are attempted). Online intervals are 95% task-level cluster bootstraps. Offline intervals are 95% bootstraps over steps; steps of one trajectory share a label, so these intervals understate uncertainty. Paired deltas resample the tasks shared by both runs under comparison; within-task deltas use only the tasks that are mixed-outcome in both arms, a small subset, so these intervals rest on few clusters and are correspondingly wide. Tables 4 and 5 and the appendix report ∼ \sim 100 paired deltas.

paragraphs.en: Our method turns the rollouts that GRPO already samples into a training signal for confidence. The G G attempts at a task each end in an outcome that labels every one of their steps, so a step can be scored by how well its stated confidence matches the attempt outcome it belongs to. We assemble this into three pieces: a group-relative advantage that credits a step for both the eventual outcome and the quality of its confidence (§ 4.1 ), a per-step reward built from a proper scoring rule that supplies the confidence term, and an optional spread term that keeps confidence away from the endpoints of the scale (§ 4.2 ). The same signal drives training on recorded offline trajectories and on the live agent alike (§ 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法将 GRPO 已经采样的 rollout 转化为用于训练置信度的信号。 G 在任务中的每次尝试最终都会产生一个结果，该结果会为每一步进行标注，因此可以通过衡量其声明的置信度与所属尝试结果之间的匹配程度来对每一步进行评分。 我们将这一过程整合为三个部分：一个群体相对优势项，用于根据最终结果和置信度的质量对某一步进行评价（§ 4.1）；一个基于适当评分规则构建的单步奖励项，该规则提供了置信度项；以及一个可选的离散度项，用于使置信度远离标度的两端（§ 4.2）。 同一信号既可用于训练已记录的离线轨迹，也可用于训练在线智能体（§ 4.3）。

paragraphs.en: Each offline training sample is a single recorded trajectory, so the within and between-task estimands of Section 3.2 cannot be formed; thus we report the pooled estimand with the depth-and-length controls it demands. Outcome-grounded training makes verbalized confidence predict eventual success in every environment (Table 1 ): pooled AUROC rises from 0.517, 0.578, and 0.462 to 0.681, 0.722, and 0.850, and success in the most-confident decile from 1.1–1.6 × \times to about 4.3 × \times the base rate (intervals and per-environment lifts in Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个离线训练样本都只记录了一条单一轨迹，因此第 3.2 节中任务内和任务间的估计量无法构建；因此，我们报告了需要深度与长度控制变量的合并估计量。 以结果为导向的训练使得用语言表述的信心能够预测每种环境中的最终成功（表 1）：合并 AUROC 从 0.517、0.578 和 0.462 提升至 0.681、0.722 和 0.850，而最自信十分位中的成功率则从基线率的 1.1–1.6 × \times 提升至约 4.3 × \times（区间及各环境中的提升幅度见附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Before training, a free white-box signal is competitive. The untrained model’s negated mean token entropy predicts success more accurately than its verbalized confidence in all three environments, and retains most of this power after residualizing on step depth and output length (Appendix G ). Training inverts the comparison. After calibration, the verbalized confidence exceeds the token entropy in every environment—most sharply on TextWorld (0.722 vs. 0.399) and WebShop (0.850 vs. 0.430)—because the mean content-token entropy falls roughly sixfold as the policy sharpens and the entropy predictor degrades, where the token distribution grows most confident on the steps that fail.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练之前，一个自由的白盒信号是具有竞争力的。 在所有三种环境中，未经训练的模型通过否定平均词元熵对成功率的预测，都比其语言化置信度更为准确；并且在根据步骤深度和输出长度进行残差处理后，这种预测能力的大部分仍然得以保留（附录 G）。 训练会反转这一比较结果。 经过校准后，在所有环境中，语言化置信度都超过了词元熵——在 TextWorld 中的差异最为显著（0.722 对比 0.399），在 WebShop 中也是如此（0.850 对比 0.430）——这是因为随着策略的锐化以及熵预测器的退化，平均内容-词元熵大约下降了六倍；而在那些失败的步骤中，词元分布的置信度则变得最高。

paragraphs.en: The pooled confidence AUROC is partly explained by trajectory depth. A predictor built from step depth and output length alone, with no access to the confidence token, reaches AUROC 0.787, 0.855, and 0.799, matching or exceeding the trained confidence AUROC on ALFWorld and TextWorld though not on WebShop (Appendix G ). A depth-independent component of the confidence nonetheless does not replicate the same result: residualizing the confidence on depth and output length leaves AUROC 0.626, 0.677, and 0.811, whereas the same residualization reduces the untrained model’s confidence to 0.534, 0.479, and 0.509, near chance. The depth-independent signal is thus a product of training. Because the pooled estimand cannot separate confidence from depth, we evaluate the depth-matched and within-task estimands in the online setting, which supports them (Section 6.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 合并后的置信度 AUROC 部分可由轨迹深度解释。 仅基于步数深度和输出长度构建的预测器（无法访问置信度标记）的 AUROC 分别为 0.787、0.855 和 0.799，在 ALFWorld 和 TextWorld 上达到或超过了训练后的置信度 AUROC，但在 WebShop 上则不然（附录 G）。 然而，置信度中独立于深度的成分并未复现相同的结果：将置信度对深度和输出长度进行残差化处理后，AUROC 分别为 0.626、0.677 和 0.811；而相同的残差化处理却将未训练模型的置信度降至 0.534、0.479 和 0.509，接近随机水平。 因此，独立于深度的信号是训练的结果。 由于合并估计量无法将置信度与深度分离，我们在在线环境中评估了深度匹配和任务内估计量，该环境支持这些估计量（第 6.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The presence of a calibration term matters more than its functional form (Table 2 ). Six reward forms—spherical, Brier, ranking, L1, logarithmic, and decision—yield overlapping AUROC between 0.820 and 0.882, statistically indistinguishable, whereas training with the task reward alone reaches only 0.559, close to the untrained 0.502. The choice of advantage estimator, by contrast, is consequential (Table 3 ): under a matched ranking-plus-spread reward, RLOO attains 0.801 and 0.876 against 0.613 and 0.676 for GRPO, and PPO with a cold-start value critic fails to learn (0.500 across two seeds) parsable response format.
paragraphs.zh: 校准项的存在比其函数形式更为重要（表2）。 六种奖励形式——球形、Brier、排序、L1、对数和决策——产生的AUROC值在0.820至0.882之间重叠，且统计上无法区分；而仅使用任务奖励进行训练时，AUROC值仅为0.559，接近未训练时的0.502。 相比之下，优势估计器的选择则具有显著影响（表3）：在匹配使用的排序加扩散奖励下，RLOO的AUROC值达到0.801和0.876，而GRPO仅为0.613和0.676；使用冷启动价值评论家的PPO则未能学习出可解析的响应格式（两个种子运行下的AUROC均为0.500）。

paragraphs.en: Calibration. ECE over all steps (10 bins) goes from 0.419 to 0.053–0.115 and the Brier score from 0.250 to 0.044–0.054, all eight paired deltas with CIs above 0; format-only moves them by + 0.010 +0.010 and + 0.003 +0.003 respectively. Mean confidence falls from 0.475 to 0.082–0.163 against a step-level success rate of 0.057, so much of the ECE and Brier drop is the agent learning the base rate; AUROC and selective execution are the discrimination evidence (reliability diagrams in Figure 2 ). A constant prediction at the step-level base rate p p has ECE near zero and a Brier score of p ⁡ ( 1 − p ) p(1-p) , so these two columns do not by themselves show discrimination; in the early window, where the base rate is 0.201, ECE goes from 0.277 to 0.051–0.133 and Brier from 0.229 to 0.137–0.157 (Appendix F ).

paragraphs.en: Selective execution. Success among the 10% most confident early steps rises from 0.493 untrained to 0.56–0.66 across the four calibration arms, three of four deltas with CIs above 0 (Table 4 , Figure 3 ); among the top 25% it rises from 0.363 to 0.415–0.446, all four delta CIs above 0. The format-only control moves neither window ( − 0.024 -0.024 and − 0.012 -0.012 ), so the gain comes from the calibration term rather than the RL format reward: against that control, Brier+ φ \varphi adds + 0.053 +0.053 [.016,.090] and Brier+dispersion + 0.082 +0.082 [.050,.114] in pooled early-window AUROC. None of this costs task success, which holds at 0.189–0.203 against 0.201 untrained, while the <conf> format parsing correctness rises from 0.978 to 1.000. The untrained agent already sorts whole tasks well: its most confident quarter succeeds at 0.557 against a 0.201 base rate. Training adds little to whole-task triage here (top-50% 0.349–0.362 against 0.362 untrained, task-level AUROC deltas all include 0) and instead sharpens the finer step-level signal behind selective execution.

Episode success rises from 0.146 to 0.262 and format correctness stays near-saturated (0.971 → \to 0.979). paragraphs.en: Results in § 6 show that training improves confidence. As part of this section, we ask what it changes. We decompose the online gain by estimand to locate where the improvement comes from (§ 7.1 ), trace it back to the first step of each episode (§ 7.2 ), and benchmark it against depth and white-box signals (§ 7.3 ) before drawing out what it means for an agent controller (§ 7.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: § 6 中的结果表明，训练能够提升置信度。 在本节中，我们将探讨这种变化具体体现在哪些方面。 我们将在线增益按估计量进行分解，以定位改进的来源（§ 7.1），追溯其到每一集的第一个步骤（§ 7.2），并将其与深度和“白盒”信号进行比较（§ 7.3），最后分析其对智能体控制器的意义（§ 7.4）。

paragraphs.en: Training’s gain is specifically between-task: it sharpens which tasks the agent will succeed at, not how it reads individual attempts (Table 5 ; Appendix Figure 6 ). Between-task early-window AUROC rises for every calibration arm (0.825 to 0.848–0.897), and only Brier+dispersion’s + 0.072 +0.072 [.029,.115] is significant. The localization suggests: the within-task estimand does not move (0.606 untrained against 0.585–0.661; paired point estimates − 0.026 -0.026 to − 0.092 -0.092 ), so the measured improvement is concentrated in task ranking, and no experiment met the pre-registered within-task criterion of § 5 . Consistent with this, the within-task all-step estimates match format-only experiment (format-only − 0.077 -0.077 , balanced+dispersion − 0.072 -0.072 ) and similar to the depth-confounded estimand of § 3.2 . Relative to the format-only control, the calibration term does incur gain on early-window within-task discrimination ( + 0.062 +0.062 [-.034,.177] for Brier+ φ \varphi , + 0.127 +0.127 [.062,.189] for Brier+dispersion), while the depth-matched within-task deltas are not significant (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 训练带来的增益具体体现在任务之间：它提升了智能体能够成功完成的任务类型，而非其处理单个尝试的方式（表5；附录图6）。 每个校准分支的任务间早期窗口AUROC均有所上升（从0.825升至0.848–0.897），但只有Brier+dispersion的+0.072 +0.072 [.029,.115]具有显著性。 定位结果表明：任务内估计量未发生变动（未经训练的0.606对比0.585–0.661；配对点估计为−0.026 -0.026至−0.092 -0.092），因此所测得的改进集中于任务排序，且没有任何实验满足第5节中预先注册的任务内标准。 与此一致的是，任务内全步骤估计值与仅格式实验的结果相符（仅格式为−0.077 -0.077，平衡+dispersion为−0.072 -0.072），并与第3.2节中受深度混淆影响的估计量相似。 相较于仅格式对照组，校准项确实在早期窗口的任务内区分能力上带来了增益（Brier+ φ \varphi 为+0.062 +0.062 [-.034,.177]，Brier+dispersion为+0.127 +0.127 [.062,.189]），而深度匹配的任务内差异则不显著（附录C）。

paragraphs.en: Training brings this task ranking forward to the very first step. Pooled step-0 AUROC rises from 0.562 [.530,.600] to 0.642–0.700 across the four calibration arms, even though the confidence is emitted after the sampled first action but before any environment feedback. The signal is task-level: within-task step-0 AUROC stays at chance (0.450–0.602, every CI spanning 0.5), so the agent is ranking which tasks it will solve rather than grading its first action . The untrained baseline confirms this is genuine improvement: at greedy decoding it emits exactly 0.50 at step 0 on every task of a 64-task probe (Appendix B ), so its sampled 0.562 is noise around a near-constant value, and the task ranking it expresses (between-task 0.825) emerges only after the first feedback. The mechanism follows from Eq. ( 2 ): uniform-outcome groups, which still arise by sampling despite mixed-outcome task selection, carry no success/failure contrast, so their gradient moves a task’s confidence toward its shared outcome at every step, step 0 included.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a training method that calibrates a language agent’s verbalized confidence by rewarding it against eventual task outcomes under GRPO. On a live multi-turn agent it turns an unreliable confidence token into a usable early-triage signal without hurting task success, and a decomposition shows the gain is between tasks: the agent learns earlier which tasks it will fail, not which attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种训练方法，该方法通过 GRPO 框架，根据最终的任务结果对语言智能体所表达出的置信度进行校准。 在真实的多轮交互智能体中，这种方法能将不可靠的置信度标记转化为可用的早期分流信号，而不会影响任务成功率；分解分析表明，这种提升体现在不同任务之间：智能体能更早地识别出哪些任务会失败，而非识别出哪些尝试会失败。

paragraphs.en: Our evidence is strongest as a between-task effect: on the live ALFWorld agent, training sharpens which tasks the agent will succeed at, and establishing the same signal at the attempt level more broadly is left to future work, as the within-task estimands move only in the early window on TextWorld and not yet on ALFWorld. Our positive live multi-turn results span two text-based environments (ALFWorld and TextWorld) at the 7B scale, and a larger 14B agent corroborates the pooled effect in Appendix E . Our live WebShop results are inconclusive: held-out success stays low for both arms, leaving too few informative held-out tasks to assess the signal (Appendix D ); extending the live study to additional model families is left to future work.

paragraphs.en: The early-window improvement might instead reflect de-censoring, where training raises the fraction of early steps that emit a confidence tag, rather than the calibration term in isolation. We probe this with a format-only control but cannot cleanly separate the two. Pooled over all emitting steps the three-way comparison is null (base 0.723, full 0.702; flip full − - base − 0.021 -0.021 [-.052,.011] ), so the pooled signal is not a censoring artifact. For the early-window gain we evaluate the control at an emission-matched checkpoint (tag rate 0.967, within 0.012 of both the base and full arms): neither the de-censoring component (format − - base, + 0.006 +0.006 [-.020,.034] ) nor the calibration component (full − - format, − 0.027 -0.027 [-.055,.000] ) is individually resolvable. By the trained endpoint the control’s own format correctness rate falls to 0.744, which confounds a like-for-like comparison. We therefore report the early-window transfer gain (within-task AUROC + 0.265 +0.265 [.107,.428] at step 0 and + 0.070 +0.070 [.010,.130] over steps 0–2) without attributing it to de-censoring or calibration in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 早期窗口的改进可能反而反映了去审查效应：训练过程提高了早期步骤中发出置信度标签的比例，而非单独由校准项引起。 我们通过仅调整格式的对照实验进行了探究，但无法明确区分这两种效应。 在所有发出步骤上进行汇总后，三者对比结果不显著（基础模型 0.723，完整模型 0.702；翻转完整模型 − 基础模型 − 0.021 -0.021 [-.052,.011]），因此汇总信号并非审查效应造成的伪影。 对于早期窗口的增益，我们在发射率匹配的检查点（标签率为 0.967，与基础模型和完整模型的差异均在 0.012 以内）评估了对照实验：去审查成分（格式 − 基础模型，+ 0.006 +0.006 [-.020,.034]）和校准成分（完整模型 − 格式，− 0.027 -0.027 [-.055,.000]）均无法单独被识别。 到训练结束时，对照实验本身的格式正确率已降至 0.744，这使得同类比较变得复杂。 因此，我们报告了早期窗口的迁移增益（任务内 AUROC 在步骤 0 时增加 +0.265 +0.265 [.107,.428]，在步骤 0–2 期间增加 +0.070 +0.070 [.010,.130]），但未将其单独归因于去审查效应或校准效应。

paragraphs.en: We repeat the online ALFWorld comparison on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, evaluating the untrained agent and a Brier+ φ \varphi checkpoint under the same held-out protocol as the 7B experiments. Episode success is 36.9% untrained and 38.1% trained, with format parsing rate of 1.000 in both experiments. The pooled matched-emission AUROC is 0.697 [.615,.781] untrained and 0.729 [.635,.818] trained; the paired (trained-untrained) Δ \Delta over the shared held-out tasks is + 0.032 +0.032 [-.016,.073] , directionally consistent with the 7B pooled gain. At 14B the trained agent still beats its untrained counterpart on both episode success and pooled AUROC, in the same direction as the 7B gain, so the pooled effect does not vanish with scale. Resolving the within-task estimand at this scale would require more held-out tasks across additional sizes and model families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上重复了在线 ALFWorld 对比实验，在 7B 实验所用的相同预留协议下，评估了未经训练的智能体以及一个 Brier+ φ \varphi 检查点。 在未训练情况下，单集成功率为 36.9%，训练后为 38.1%；两项实验中格式解析率均为 1.000。 合并匹配排放的 AUROC 在未训练时为 0.697 [.615,.781]，训练后为 0.729 [.635,.818]；在共享预留任务上，配对（训练-未训练）的 Δ \Delta 为 +0.032 +0.032 [-.016,.073]，方向上与 7B 的合并增益一致。 在此处无法识别任务内的早期窗口估计量，因为仅有六个未训练和七个训练后的预留任务同时包含成功和失败的种子，数量太少，不足以得出可靠的配对任务内差异。 在 14B 规模下，训练后的智能体在单集成功率和合并 AUROC 上仍优于其未训练版本，方向与 7B 的增益一致，因此合并效应并未随规模扩大而消失。 要在此规模下确定任务内的估计量，需要在更多额外规模和模型家族中收集更多的预留任务。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments build on three agentic environments and the Qwen2.5-Instruct model family ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , adapted with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) using the TRL library ( von Werra et al., 2020 ) for training.
